channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: As A.I. Accelerates, Governments Are Increasingly Being Left Behind
item.description: The gap between technology and policymaking has gotten wider than ever with artificial intelligence, leaving a global policy vacuum as A.I. models rapidly advance.

item.title: NPR: South Africa reels from spate of mass shootings that killed 38 people in a week
item.description: On Saturday night, there were separate mass shootings near South Africa's two largest cities.

item.title: BBC News: Burnham proposes NHS-style social care system for England
item.description: The prime minister told the BBC that social care in England is "as unfair as American healthcare".

item.title: The Guardian: ‘Hell on earth’: last residents eat weeds to survive in Russian-occupied Oleshky
item.description: Ukrainian forces airdrop supplies to city where bodies are left to be eaten by dogs because of deadly risk from drones The phone message sent out of Russian-occupied Oleshky was grimly matter-of-fact: food had finally ru…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Strait of Hormuz tensions linger as Iran and US move further from a deal
item.description: There are fears of renewed fighting between the US and Iran, after President Trump rejected a deal.

item.title: Ars Technica: How the Smithsonian became the latest front in Trump’s culture war
item.description: The Smithsonian has faced withering pressure from the Trump administration.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Who Killed Paulina Borsook’s Career?
item.description: A quarter-century ago, Borsook published a wildly prophetic, penetrating book about Silicon Valley called Cyberselfish. Then she disappeared.

item.title: WIRED Science: The Data Center Backlash Should Also Be a Climate Reckoning. It Isn’t Yet
item.description: Climate groups are latching onto the data center opposition movement, but it remains to be seen if they can get people to care about the facilities’ impact on the atmosphere.

item.title: WIRED Business: Appeals Court Lets the Pentagon Designate Anthropic a Supply-Chain Risk
item.description: The AI lab had argued multiple violations of its rights, but a divided panel of judges sided with the Trump administration.

item.title: The New Yorker: The President vs. the Press
item.description: Donald Trump’s behavior cannot be called unexpected at this point. What was noteworthy last week, however, was the way that the media responded.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Your Weekly Horoscopes by Madame Clairevoyant: September 27–October 3
item.description: As Mars enters Leo, now’s the time to take big swings.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Linda Evangelista Sells Her Chelsea Penthouse Loft for $6.75 million
item.description: The Big Six supermodel cut her original asking price by nearly 30 percent to make the sale.
